reserveReview.rationale: The whitepaper and product page specify at least 30% cash at regulated EU credit institutions and up to 70% euro government MMFs or similar investments. These are policy bounds, not measured weights. The issuer's EURW guide separately describes cash and overnight deposits, while its business-account page mentions cash and AAA-rated MMFs. No dated portfolio report reconciles these descriptions. The reserve envelope remains one explicitly unclassified basket; no 30/70 allocation is invented. The product page claims monthly independent reports but links a smart-contract security audit. The download centre yielded only navigation and a whitepaper link on this review, so its incomplete rendering is not proof that reports do not exist. No exact-token financial reserve reconciliation was retrieved from the accessible materials. Medium legacy risk records the unresolved permitted-investment basket, not an observed loss.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer whitepaper and product-page reserve eligibility, with no observed cash/investment allocation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No dated portfolio inventory, allocation, named reserve bank, fund identity, maturity schedule or exact-token independent financial reconciliation was retrieved. The current cash/overnight guide and cash/MMF disclosures are not reconciled by a dated holdings report. Corporate financial audit and code audit do not establish reserve assurance.
